major_cooldowns.name: Dancing Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, but delay it if you are already holding an Exterminate charge so the buff window is not wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Consumption
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower it to rank 1 whenever the hard-cast Dancing Rune Weapon is not active, and as San'layn outside Gift of the San'layn hold it to empower to rank 3 and fire it the instant Dancing Rune Weapon ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses; it is a talent choice named explicitly in both hero-tree priorities, so treated as a real button.

major_cooldowns.name: Death and Decay
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Recast and stand in it whenever its buff is not currently active or you get a Crimson Scourge proc.

major_cooldowns.name: Raise Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it off the global cooldown as soon as it is available, ideally in the opener, to keep your permanent ghoul out.

defensives.name: Vampiric Blood
defensives.usage_rule: Use it as close to on cooldown as you can, either ahead of incoming damage or to top off your health, since it boosts healing and adds a stacking absorb.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for a heavy physical or unavoidable damage spike, since it also clears loss-of-control effects.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it into a burst of magic damage to absorb the hit and convert the absorbed amount into Runic Power.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it on a heavy magic damage phase to reduce incoming magic damage for yourself and anyone standing in it.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Use it for the self-healing it grants through your life-drain effects, or to break out of a fear or charm.

rules.description: San'layn opener: Death's Caress into Dancing Rune Weapon
rules.action: Pre-place Death and Decay while Death's Caress is in flight, then open with Dancing Rune Weapon, Blood Boil, and two Vampiric Strikes before your first Death Strike.

rules.description: Hold Dancing Rune Weapon while Exterminate is up
rules.action: Delay Dancing Rune Weapon until you have spent your Exterminate charges so their Bone Shield refresh is not wasted.
Press Marrowrend, or another Bone Shield generator, before it is about to expire or drop below its charge floor.

rules.description: Keep Blood Plague active on your target
rules.action: Cast Blood Boil whenever your target does not have Blood Plague on it.

rules.description: Spend Crimson Scourge into Death and Decay
rules.action: Recast Death and Decay and stand in it as soon as you get a Crimson Scourge proc.

rules.description: Spend Boiling Point into Blood Boil
rules.action: Cast Blood Boil as soon as you get a Boiling Point proc.
Spend your Exterminate charges with Marrowrend before Reaper's Mark detonates so you do not waste the guaranteed Bone Shield refresh.

rules.description: Spend Death Strike at high Runic Power
rules.action: Hold Death Strike until Runic Power is high unless you need the heal right now, so you never overcap Runic Power.
